citation.authors: Wang Z, Qiu B, Li R, Han Y et al

cited_by.title: Creatine supplements: strength, kidneys and your kidney test

record.population: Adults under 50 in 23 trials of creatine with resistance training (460 men and 49 women across the included studies)
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised trials
record.finding: Creatine with resistance training raised upper-body strength by 4.4 kg and lower-body strength by 11.4 kg more than placebo. Males gained strength; females showed no significant gains, though only three studies included women. Ethnicity was not reported.
record.note: Mostly young men. Strength outcomes, not health outcomes.
